title: Saturn's class: road trip edition.
old_caption:
Late once without a text, or late every single time?
Saturn's road trip pop quiz: once is life, always is a pattern worth noticing.

title: Saturn's class: boundaries.
old_caption:
Think a boundary means building a wall?
Saturn swaps the wall for a gate with a kind sign. Boundaries are love too.

title: Saturn's class: your own standards.
old_caption:
Got a long list of what you want in a partner?
Saturn flips it around: do you do all this? Be the partner you're asking for.

title: Dear Scorpio: the detective.
old_caption:
Scorpio, do you know everything about them while they know nothing about you?
The detective learns to go first. Be known, too.

title: Dear Seattle.
old_caption:
Hiding behind a book at the coffee shop again?
Cozy is good, hiding forever isn't. Look up and say hi.

title: Your 7th house is open.
old_caption:
Ever wonder what kind of partner you keep being drawn to?
The 7th house is partnership. The sign on its door gives you a clue.

title: The ghost takes the sheet off.
old_caption:
What happens when the ghost finally shows up as itself?
Off comes the sheet, and the date thinks it is cute. Nobody hides forever.

title: Six couples, one sky.
old_caption:
What sign sits opposite yours on the wheel?
Six opposite pairs share one sky. Opposites do not complete you, they stretch you.

title: Space City, you did it.
old_caption:
Houston was first. Now the whole state is up next.
The stars light up Texas, and Sagittarius already packed the van.

title: There's a stowaway.
old_caption:
Ever not asked to come along because you assumed they'd say no?
The ghost hides in the trunk, then finally asks out loud. Worst case is a kind no.
